modern: Get into the habit, as far as possible, whenever anything is done by anyone, of asking yourself: For what purpose is this man doing this? But begin with yourself, and examine yourself first.
original: Accustom thyself as much as possible on the occasion of anything being done by any person to inquire with thyself, For what object is this man doing this? But begin with thyself, and examine thyself first.
